name: Skyskipper Duo
description: Flying. When this creature enters, exile up to one other target creature you control. Return it to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
couldNotDerive: The delayed return clause -- correctly absent (DelayedTrigger suppressed) rather than shown wrong.
notes: The exile half is fully correct (node E: owner:me, not:self, qty:0..1, target -- the examiner's own prose just didn't render owner:me as explicit 'you control', not a data issue). Same known_gap_classes['Delayed conditional return (DelayedTrigger + WithCountersType)'] shape as Parting Gust/Salvation Swan (here unconditional, but the timing mechanic itself is still unrepresented) -- consistent with those, not counted as a full match since the delayed-return clause is a substantial, entirely-missing part of the printed text. Added to that gap class's card list.
